rationale: The idea is conceptually plausible but key assumptions are unproven; proceed to the proposed pilot reversible affinity-capture -> SEC experiments (≥3 independent lots) with orthogonal protection assays and a validated exogenous spike‑in to test preservation of membrane integrity, spike recovery, and qualitative yield. Retain focus on validating reversible low‑shear elution chemistry and closed/cassette manufacturability during these tests; if pilot failures occur, de‑prioritize this path.
